name: Vivalto Santé
note: French private-hospital group founded in 2009 by Daniel Caille. Its controlling shareholder is Vivalto Partners (Daniel Caille's management company), alongside institutional investors (IK Partners, MACSF, Bpifrance, Mubadala, Arkéa Capital, Groupe Crédit Agricole, BNPP) and over 1,200 doctor shareholders. Not listed; no state control.
